{{Quote|They savaged the outpost at Furies Gate, then took the Giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr and their moons&mdash;before we blunted their attack on Tython.|Je'daii Master Daegen Lok's log|<ref name="DOTJ 11" />}}
When the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Invasion of the Tython system|invaded]] the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] in [[25,793 BBY]], their first strike was an '''attack''' on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Fury Station]]. Fury Station was an outpost of the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Settled Worlds]] in orbit over [[Furies Gate]], the farthest [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tythos]]. Fury Station was devastated during the assault, and following the attack, the Infinite Empire [[Capture of Obri|captured]] [[Capture of Mawr|both]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system, [[Obri]] and [[Mawr]], and their [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The attacks were subsequently recorded in a log created by [[Je'daii Master]] [[Daegen Lok]].<ref name="DOTJ 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Fury Station was mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War]]''. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DOTJ 11" /> on [[November 20]], [[2013]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/22-793/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-Force-War-1|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—Force War #1}}</ref>
